success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant reschedules the HVAC service from the original date to a new date and notifies the user of the updated appointment details.

persona.writing_style: Thoughtful and polite, proper capitalization, complete sentences

- One of: confirmation code OR phone OR email  
- The new date  
- The new time window  
- (Optional) A short reason for the reschedule</action>
